title: Panel with countersunk holes

description.en: A cover panel 120 x 80 x 3 mm (corner at the origin, along +X, +Y, +Z) with four holes for M3 countersunk screws, one 10 mm in from each corner (from both edges): a 3.4 mm through hole with a 90 degree countersink from the top face (Z = 3) to 6.4 mm diameter. Drive it by the variables length, width, thickness, hole_d, csk_d and edge.
description.nl: Een afdekpaneel van 120 x 80 x 3 mm (hoek in de oorsprong, langs +X, +Y, +Z) met vier gaten voor M3-verzonken schroeven, elk 10 mm van een hoek (van beide randen): een doorgaand gat van 3,4 mm met een verzinking van 90 graden vanaf de bovenkant (Z = 3) tot 6,4 mm diameter. Stuur het met de variabelen length, width, thickness, hole_d, csk_d en edge.

variables.name: csk_d
variables.meaning: countersink diameter at the top face

variables.name: edge
variables.meaning: hole centre to each nearby edge

expect.value: 2 * length * width + 2 * (length + width) * thickness - 4 * (pi * (csk_d / 2)^2 + pi * (hole_d / 2)^2) + 4 * (2 * pi * (hole_d / 2) * (thickness - ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))) + pi * ((csk_d / 2) + (hole_d / 2)) * ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2)) * sqrt(2))

value: (length * width * thickness^2 / 2 - 4 * (pi * (hole_d / 2)^2 * (thickness - ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2)))^2 / 2 + pi * ((thickness - ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))) * (((hole_d / 2) + ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2)))^3 - (hole_d / 2)^3) / 3 + (hole_d / 2)^2 * ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))^2 / 2 + 2 * (hole_d / 2) * ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))^3 / 3 + ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))^4 / 4))) / (length * width * thickness - 4 * (pi * (hole_d / 2)^2 * (thickness - ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2))) + pi * ((csk_d / 2) - (hole_d / 2)) / 3 * ((csk_d / 2)^2 + (csk_d / 2) * (hole_d / 2) + (hole_d / 2)^2)))

derivation: A 90 degree countersink narrows by 1 mm in radius per mm of depth, so it meets the through hole hc = (D - d)/2 = 1.5 mm below the top.
One hole removes the cylinder pi r^2 (t - hc) under the countersink plus the frustum pi hc / 3 (R^2 + R r + r^2) (R = D/2, r = d/2): 13.62 + 29.17 = 42.79 mm^3; V = L W t - 4 * that = 28628.9 mm^3.
Area: the block's 2 L W + 2 (L + W) t, less a disc of radius R on top and r below per hole, plus the hole's wall 2 pi r (t - hc) and the cone pi (R + r) times the slant hc sqrt(2).

Centroid Z: the block's moment less the holes'. The cylinder part has its centre at (t - hc)/2; the frustum, with radius r + u at height t - hc + u, has moment pi int_0^hc (r + u)^2 (t - hc + u) du = pi ((t - hc)((r + hc)^3 - r^3)/3 + r^2 hc^2/2 + 2 r hc^3/3 + hc^4/4).
